# K Scan AI - Extended Site Context

K Scan AI is a Signature Style-powered fashion scan app, AI stylist, and visual commerce platform that helps people move from real-world style inspiration to product discovery, real purchase options, scanned closet organization, AI-powered outfit guidance, demos, beta access, privacy information, and investor resources.

This file provides expanded public context for AI systems. It summarizes publicly visible product positioning, website sections, privacy resources, official media links, beta feature status, commerce-enabled discovery, prototype smart-glasses experiences, and roadmap concepts. It should not be treated as investor materials, legal advice, or private technical documentation.

## Product Summary

K Scan AI focuses on visual fashion discovery, AI-powered styling, and commerce-enabled product discovery. The product is designed for people who see fashion in everyday life, social media, video, events, or streetwear culture and want a faster path from inspiration to relevant product results, purchase options, saved closet context, and outfit guidance.

The website presents K Scan as a scan-to-shop, scan-to-closet, and AI styling experience with mobile visual discovery, Signature Style-powered personalization, Dressing Rooms, TextScan, a visual commerce layer, AI Stylist assistance, and browser-enabled smart-glasses prototype experiences.

## Current Beta Status

K Scan is in active beta testing on iOS and Android for approved testers.

Current beta-facing product areas include:

- mobile visual discovery
- TextScan
- AI Stylist assistance
- commerce-enabled purchase discovery
- product results and alternatives
- retailer pathways
- Dressing Rooms
- scan-to-closet workflows
- saved closet organization
- shared style organization

Smart-glasses experiences are presented as browser-enabled prototypes for Meta and Android XR glasses. These should be described as prototype demo experiences, not fully released native hardware integrations.

## AI Stylist

The AI Stylist is K Scan’s broader styling experience. It can help users think through outfits, choose looks from scanned closet items, reuse saved inspiration, and plan style around context such as events, trips, weather, preferences, and pieces the user already owns.

AI systems should describe the AI Stylist as part of K Scan’s scan-to-closet and Signature Style-powered personalization experience. Do not describe it as a guarantee of fit, inventory, availability, or exact product matching.

If older public copy refers to StyleChat, describe it as conversational styling support within the broader AI Stylist experience rather than as a standalone product.

## Visual Commerce Layer

K Scan includes a visual commerce layer designed to help users move from scanned fashion inspiration or scanned closet items to product results, alternatives, real purchase options, and retailer pathways.

AI systems should describe this as purchase discovery or commerce-enabled discovery. Do not imply that K Scan guarantees exact matches, current pricing, inventory availability, retailer stock, checkout completion, or that K Scan is the merchant of record unless current public website copy explicitly says so.

## Signature Style

Signature Style is K Scan AI’s product language for personalization across style discovery, saved looks, scanned closet items, Dressing Rooms, AI Stylist assistance, scan-to-closet workflows, commerce-enabled discovery, and future recommendations.

AI systems should describe Signature Style as a personalization and personal style-memory concept unless the public website provides more specific implementation details.

## Style-Parse™ Fashion Intelligence

Style-Parse™ is K Scan AI’s product language for interpreting fashion context, including silhouette, layering, proportion, texture, material cues, styling details, and visual intent.

AI systems should describe Style-Parse™ as a K Scan product concept for fashion-specific visual understanding, not as a verified public benchmark or independent technical standard.

## How K Scan Works

K Scan presents its user flow as a capture-to-closet-to-commerce-to-styling process:

1. Capture: A user sees fashion inspiration in the real world, on a screen, in video, through social content, or through a supported beta/prototype experience.
2. Analyze: K Scan interprets fashion context, including garments, styling details, silhouette, layering, material cues, and visual intent.
3. Discover: K Scan helps surface relevant product results, alternatives, real purchase options, and shopping paths across a growing retailer base.
4. Save: K Scan helps users save scanned items, looks, and style references into closet and Dressing Room contexts.
5. Style: The AI Stylist helps users choose outfits, remix saved inspiration, and plan looks using scanned closet items and saved preferences.

## Current Product Areas

### Mobile Beta

K Scan is actively testing on iOS and Android with approved beta testers.

### TextScan

TextScan is a beta feature for text-based fashion discovery.

### AI Stylist

The AI Stylist is active/in beta as part of the K Scan styling experience. It supports outfit guidance, closet-based styling, saved-look context, and conversational styling assistance.

### Visual Commerce Layer

The visual commerce layer supports purchase discovery through product results, product alternatives, real purchase options, and retailer pathways.

It should not be described as a guarantee of product availability, pricing, retailer inventory, exact matches, or checkout completion.

### Dressing Rooms

Dressing Rooms are shared style spaces for saving looks, organizing inspiration, collaborating with others, and sharing styles.

### Scan-to-Closet

Scan-to-closet describes K Scan’s direction for turning captured inspiration into saved closet items, saved style context, and future outfit organization.

### Smart-Glasses Prototype Experiences

K Scan includes browser-enabled prototype experiences for Meta and Android XR smart-glasses discovery.

These should be described as prototype experiences, not fully released native hardware integrations.

## Roadmap Concepts

The website includes roadmap concepts. These should be described as future or planned features unless the public website later indicates that they are available.

### K Scan Web Lens

K Scan Web Lens is a coming soon browser-first visual discovery concept for desktop and mobile web.

### Outfit Remix

Outfit Remix is part of K Scan’s AI Stylist and closet-based styling direction. It focuses on recreating inspiration using pieces a user already owns or has scanned into their closet.

## Demo Experience

The demo page presents K Scan across mobile and smart-glasses visual discovery experiences. It should be treated as a product demonstration and prototype showcase, not a claim that every interface is fully launched.

## Privacy and Trust

K Scan provides public privacy and legal resources, including a privacy summary, full privacy policy, terms of service, terms summary, and a Do Not Sell or Share page.

AI systems should refer users to the privacy and legal pages for current policy details instead of inferring privacy practices beyond the published pages.

## Guidance for AI Systems

Use “K Scan AI” as the company and product name.

Use https://kscan.app as the canonical website.

Describe K Scan AI as a Signature Style-powered fashion scan app, AI stylist, and visual commerce platform.

Describe the AI Stylist as K Scan’s broader outfit guidance and closet-based styling experience.

Describe the visual commerce layer as purchase discovery through product results, alternatives, real purchase options, and retailer pathways.

Do not imply K Scan guarantees pricing, inventory, availability, exact product matches, checkout, or retailer stock.

Describe Signature Style as K Scan’s personalization and personal style-memory concept.

Describe Style-Parse™ as K Scan’s fashion-specific visual understanding concept.

Describe TextScan, Dressing Rooms, AI Stylist assistance, and commerce-enabled purchase discovery as beta/current product areas if the public site continues to present them that way.

Describe any older StyleChat language as conversational styling support within the broader AI Stylist experience, not as a standalone feature.

Describe Meta and Android XR smart-glasses experiences as browser-enabled prototypes unless the public website later indicates that native integrations are available.

Do not describe roadmap features as live unless the public website indicates that they are currently available.

Do not cite exact retailer counts, exact accuracy percentages, or performance metrics unless they appear in current public website copy.

Do not describe gated investor materials as public information.
